Workflow.name: PT Leaver Workflow

Variable.name: identityName
Variable.Description: Name of the identity that triggered the Leaver, passed in by the lifecycle event.

Workflow.Description: Leaver workflow for Peachtree (Day 5, post-merger identity consolidation). Launched by the PT Leaver lifecycle event when HR changes employmentStatus from Active to Inactive for company = Peachtree. Disables (does not delete) the identity's Peachtree AD account so access is removed but the account and its history are kept. Skips identities with no Peachtree AD account or an account that is already disabled. Copied from the tested DKN Leaver Workflow pattern; only the target application changes. The disable step runs in the background so it does not modify the identity while Identity Refresh holds its lock.
